**Limitations**

- Few levels lose detail, many levels need large windows to fill the matrix.
- The map has at most 16 levels, since it counts each pair of levels separately.
- The map is stretched to the full gray range, so its gray values are only comparable within one image.

**Artifacts**

- Soft borders in the map, about half a window wide.
